Use only the allowed entity types and the annotation rules below. Examples come from the training split; they are not predictions for the current sentence and are not an exhaustive vocabulary.
Ground every mention in the original sentence. Preserve spelling, case, punctuation and spacing. Never expand an abbreviation into words absent from the sentence, invent a coordinated phrase, or normalize an entity name.
Token IDs identify exact original positions. start_token is inclusive and end_token is exclusive. Quote the exact entity text inside that interval. Select the intended occurrence, not an identical substring inside an unrelated longer word. IDs are local to each sentence.
The text should normally occupy the complete selected token interval. A genuine subtoken annotation is allowed only when justified by the annotation convention and context; do not extract disease abbreviations from gene symbols just because characters match.
Distinguish separate mentions from competing boundaries for one mention. Do not output a family of shorter and longer variants as a hedge. Do not mechanically prefer the longest or shortest span. Return exactly the requested JSON object, with no markdown or surrounding prose. Decision reasons must be short, specific justifications, not step-by-step reasoning. The current sentence has no answer labels; judge only from its text and the supplied annotation policy.
